The '''Feast of Prosperity chef battle''' was a cooking competition within the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] to decide which of the two [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]&mdash;[[Duuba]] or [[Gaboorga]]&mdash;should lead the organization of the event. The final decision was announced by the [[Feast of Prosperity head judge|head judge]], giving the victor control over the Feast of Prosperity.<ref name="The Future" />

==Behind the scenes==
The chef battle appears as the third part of the "Feast of Prosperity" storyline in the update 6.1.4 to the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Future" />
